data.one_liner: A library for modifying YAML files.
data.what_it_does: A library for modifying YAML files, for example you can modify pubspec.yaml by this library. It provides utilities to load, modify, and serialize back to YAML strings.
use_when: You need to programmatically modify and write YAML files like pubspec.yaml
You want to parse YAML into a modifiable structure and convert it back to a string
avoid_when: You only need to read YAML files without modifying them
You need complex schema validation for YAML
strengths: Enables modifying existing YAML files programmatically
weaknesses: Limited features mentioned beyond basic modification and serialization

alternatives.name: yaml
alternatives.why_pick_it: yaml is the standard package for parsing YAML, though yaml_modify is specifically for modifying and writing back.
